text:
anya: heads-up — new quantized reranker rw-rerank-3b-ptq onboard shows ~4.7% NDCG@10 drop vs fp16 on our dev. Need quick triage: dataset vs formatting vs PTQ seed?

matt: yikes. is this on the canonical eval harness? which holdout?

anya: yes harness v3.2, holdout=dev_v1_longtail (5k queries). ran fp16 and int8-ptq with identical prompts.

zane: do you have per-slice NDCG? longtail vs core?

anya: core nearly flat, longtail >75th percentile is where loss shows. median doc length ~87 tokens for that slice.

eva: could be candidate normalization or truncation differences. did you run the same candidate pipeline?

anya: I only did whitespace collapse. dedupe off. fp16 run used tokenizer v0.9.3 but PTQ run pulled v0.10.0 from the runtime image (oops).

matt: tokenizer change + quantization is a classic interaction. tokenization shifts can flip ranks even without model changes.

zane: also check whether we're accidentally changing doc concat order or adding separators. small formatting diffs hit long docs harder.

anya: good call. I'll run three controlled probes:
1) tokenizer parity (force v0.9.3 for PTQ)
2) candidate normalization (lowercase + strip punctuation + collapse spaces)
3) disable prefix caching in runtime to rule out KV edge effects

relevance-bot: eval-job queued: 3287654321-ptq-recheck (will post when done).

matt: also run a bootstrap significance test (n=1k resamples) and provide 95% CI on delta NDCG@10 and MRR. if CI excludes 0 we escalate.

eva: include top-20 flipped queries (fp16 vs ptq) and their doc text diffs — sometimes the flips point to truncation/sep token issues.

zane: add a small deterministic seed sweep for PTQ (3 seeds) — PTQ sometimes has seed-dependent weight permutation effects.

anya: running stratified 1k subset first (longtail-heavy) to get quick signal, then full 5k. command I'm running:

```
eval_harness run \
  --model rw-rerank-3b-ptq \
  --tokenizer v0.9.3 \
  --candidates-normalize "lower,strip_punct" \
  --prefix-cache enabled \
  --holdout dev_v1_longtail \
  --bootstrap 1000 \
  --seed-sweep 3 
```

anya: ETA ~45–60m for the 1k probe. will post the bootstrap CIs + top flips.

matt: if it's still sig, let's run a paired-sample analysis and then dig into model internals (attention patterns on long docs) — ping infra if we need CPU vs GPU parity for tokenizer binary.

eva: also check token counts pre/post normalization and document effective truncation length. tiny off-by-one truncation can truncate the golden passage for longtail queries.

anya: noted — I'll include histograms of token counts and a small table of top 10 queries where token_count_fp16 != token_count_ptq. will report back here. :thumbsup:
